exercises.title: GIN for jsonb containment
exercises.problemHtml:
Marketing filters events by JSON properties: SELECT count(*) FROM event WHERE props @> '{"plan": "pro"}'. A B-tree cannot look inside a document. Create the index type that can.

Sample tables (chapters 9–10)

event (id identity PK, user_id int, status text, amount numeric(10,2), email text, created_at timestamptz, props jsonb)
      20 000 rows: user_id 1–2000 (10 events each) · status pending 1 %, done ~33 %, active ~66 %
      email 'user<g>@example.com' (unique) · created_at every 10 minutes from 2024-01-01 · props {"plan": "free"|"pro", "device": …}
users (id PK, name, country)   2 000 rows
No index except the primary keys. Statistics are collected (ANALYZE) so the planner behaves like on a real server.
Helpers: plan_nodes(q) / plan_text(q) / plan_rows(q) / plan_analyze(q) print the plan of query text q.

The lesson used 500 000 rows; 20 000 deterministic rows are enough for the planner to make the same choices. The grader is PostgreSQL 18 (WASM).

Requirements

  • CREATE INDEX … ON event USING GIN (props).
  • The containment query must use it.

Bảng mẫu (chương 9–10)

      email 'user<g>@example.com' (unique) · created_at every 10 minutes from 2024-01-01 · props {"plan": "free"|"pro", "device": …}
users (id PK, name, country)   2 000 rows
No index except the primary keys. Statistics are collected (ANALYZE) so the planner behaves like on a real server.
Helpers: plan_nodes(q) / plan_text(q) / plan_rows(q) / plan_analyze(q) print the plan of query text q.

Bài giảng dùng 500 000 dòng; 20 000 dòng tất định đủ để bộ lập kế hoạch chọn giống vậy. Máy chấm là PostgreSQL 18 (WASM).

Yêu cầu

  • CREATE INDEX … ON event USING GIN (props).
  • Truy vấn chứa phải dùng nó.

exercises.title: BRIN: a tiny index for time-ordered data
exercises.problemHtml:
event is append-only: rows arrive in created_at order. Create a BRIN index on created_at — a few hundred bytes instead of hundreds of kilobytes — and check that the day query WHERE created_at >= '2024-03-01' AND created_at < '2024-03-02' can use it.

Sample tables (chapters 9–10)

event (id identity PK, user_id int, status text, amount numeric(10,2), email text, created_at timestamptz, props jsonb)
      20 000 rows: user_id 1–2000 (10 events each) · status pending 1 %, done ~33 %, active ~66 %
      email 'user<g>@example.com' (unique) · created_at every 10 minutes from 2024-01-01 · props {"plan": "free"|"pro", "device": …}
users (id PK, name, country)   2 000 rows
No index except the primary keys. Statistics are collected (ANALYZE) so the planner behaves like on a real server.
Helpers: plan_nodes(q) / plan_text(q) / plan_rows(q) / plan_analyze(q) print the plan of query text q.

The lesson used 500 000 rows; 20 000 deterministic rows are enough for the planner to make the same choices. The grader is PostgreSQL 18 (WASM).

Requirements

  • CREATE INDEX … ON event USING BRIN (created_at).
  • No B-tree on created_at.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: For huge append-only tables (logs, events, sensor data) BRIN gives "skip most of the table" for a fraction of the size of a B-tree. The lesson measured it on 500 000 rows.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Với bảng chỉ-chèn khổng lồ (log, sự kiện, dữ liệu cảm biến), BRIN cho "bỏ qua phần lớn bảng" với kích thước bằng một phần nhỏ của B-tree. Bài giảng đã đo trên 500 000 dòng.

kiem.moTa: It is BRIN and much smaller than a B-tree would be|||Nó là BRIN và nhỏ hơn hẳn B-tree

BRIN on a randomly ordered column (email): every block range covers everything, the index is useless.|||BRIN trên cột thứ tự ngẫu nhiên (email): mỗi dải khối bao mọi giá trị, chỉ mục vô dụng.

exercises.title: At most one pending order per customer: a partial unique index
exercises.problemHtml:
The checkout must never create a second pending order for the same customer (a double click). Paid, shipped and cancelled orders are unlimited. Enforce it in the database with one index.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • CREATE UNIQUE INDEX … ON orders (customer_id) WHERE status = 'pending'.
  • A plain UNIQUE constraint cannot have a WHERE — this is why the index form exists.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Trang thanh toán không bao giờ được tạo đơn pending thứ hai cho cùng một khách (bấm đúp). Đơn paid, shipped, cancelled thì không giới hạn. Ép luật này trong CSDL bằng một chỉ mục.

CSDL mẫu: CT Shop mini (dự án lab của khoá, cắt nhỏ)

category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)

Đúng 8 bảng của Lab 1–9 (ở schema public thay vì shop); dữ liệu là một lát nhỏ của dữ liệu lab — cùng cây danh mục, cùng id/SKU/giá sản phẩm. Mọi id là GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: bỏ cột id khi INSERT. Thời gian là timestamptz hiển thị theo giờ Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Script đầy đủ: tab ctshop.sql.

Yêu cầu

  • CREATE UNIQUE INDEX … ON orders (customer_id) WHERE status = 'pending'.
  • Ràng buộc UNIQUE thường không có WHERE — đó là lý do có dạng chỉ mục.

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Chỉ mục unique từng phần diễn đạt được luật kiểu "mỗi Y chỉ một X đang hoạt động" mà ràng buộc thường không làm được. Lần chèn đơn pending thứ hai hỏng một cách nguyên tử, kể cả khi hai yêu cầu chạy đua.

exercises.title: No double booking: EXCLUDE with a GiST index
exercises.problemHtml:
Lab rooms are booked by time range. Add a constraint no_overlap to booking so that two bookings of the same room can never overlap in time, while different rooms may overlap freely. (The usual form room_id WITH = needs the extension btree_gist, which this grader does not have; turn the room id into a one-point range: int4range(room_id, room_id, '[]') WITH =.)

room (id PK, name) — 3 rooms
booking (id identity PK, room_id → room, who, during tstzrange) — empty

Requirements

  • ALTER TABLE booking ADD CONSTRAINT no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (int4range(room_id, room_id, '[]') WITH =, during WITH &&).
  • Back-to-back bookings ([9:00, 10:00) then [10:00, 11:00)) must be allowed.

(Dạng thường room_id WITH = cần extension btree_gist, máy chấm này không có; hãy biến id phòng thành khoảng một điểm: int4range(room_id, room_id, '[]') WITH =.)

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: An exclusion constraint generalizes UNIQUE from "equal" to any operator — here "same room AND overlapping time". It is backed by a GiST index and, like UNIQUE, is safe under concurrent inserts. Checking overlaps in the application cannot be made race-free without locks.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Ràng buộc loại trừ tổng quát hoá UNIQUE từ "bằng nhau" sang toán tử bất kỳ — ở đây là "cùng phòng VÀ chồng lấn thời gian". Nó dựa trên một chỉ mục GiST và, như UNIQUE, an toàn khi chèn đồng thời. Kiểm chồng lấn ở ứng dụng không thể không có kẽ hở nếu thiếu khoá.
